pages.text: Cut two Iron or Zinc Nuggets into twenty large cores. Run the wad sequence once with four Paper to make thirty Wads.
Mix two Gunpowder, one Charcoal and 250 mB Water into ten cakes. Smoke just one cake, then press it into four charges.$(br2)Run the ammunition pattern four times.

The lot yields sixteen rounds. Four cores, fourteen wads and nine undried cakes remain.$(br2)Fuel and machine construction are additional. Four rounds require one assembly cycle; sixty-four rounds require sixteen cycles.
Carry the finished ammo in your inventory. Hold either gun and use the configured TaCZ Reload key. Both guns hold one round. Wait for the reload animation to finish.
